name: Walk
cue: Brisk but comfortable, arms swinging, look ahead.

name: March on the spot
cue: Lift the knees, pump the arms in rhythm, elbows bent, fists soft.

name: Heel digs
cue: Alternate heels to the front, toes up, punch out with each dig, soft knee on the standing leg.

name: Knee lifts
cue: Stand tall, bring alternate knees up to touch the opposite hand, abs tight.

name: Shoulder rolls
cue: Keep marching, roll the shoulders forwards then backwards, arms loose.

name: Mini squat
cue: Feet shoulder-width, bend the knees only a little (about 10 cm), back straight, come up and squeeze the glutes.

name: Star jumps
cue: Jump up spreading arms and legs into a star, land softly with knees together and hands by the sides.

name: Tap backs
cue: Step one leg back and swing both arms forward, alternate legs in a continuous rhythm; jump the switch for spotty dogs.

name: Three-quarter press-up
cue: Hands under shoulders, knees on the floor, lower the chest to about 5 cm off the floor and push back up.

name: Wall press-up
cue: Arm's length from the wall, hands at chest height, elbows tucked, bend the arms to bring the chest to the wall and push back.

name: Bench dip
cue: Hands gripping the edge of a chair or the floor behind you, hips lifted, bend the elbows to about 90 degrees and push back up.

name: Triceps kickback
cue: Kneel and lean forward, elbow raised behind you at 90 degrees, straighten the arm back, bend and repeat.

name: Band shoulder press
cue: Band under both feet, fists at shoulder height, press overhead until the hands meet, widen the grip on the way down.

name: Band lunge with shoulder press
cue: Band under the front foot; drop into a lunge while pressing the arms overhead, return and repeat.

name: Band biceps curl
cue: Band under one or both feet, palms out, elbows tucked, curl the fists to the shoulders and lower slowly.

name: Band lateral raise
cue: Band under both feet, palms in, raise straight arms to shoulder height without shrugging.

name: Calf raise
cue: Hands on a wall or chair, rise slowly onto the toes and lower the heels under control.

name: Side-lying leg raise
cue: Lie on one side, bottom knee bent, raise the top leg without letting the hips tilt back.

name: One-leg kickback
cue: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent at 90 degrees and raise the leg behind you, squeezing the glute.

name: Sit to stand
cue: Sit on the edge of a chair, feet hip-width, lean forward, stand up with the legs (not the arms), sit back down slowly.

name: Standing sideways leg lift
cue: Hands on a chair, raise one leg out to the side keeping the back and hips straight, no tilting.

name: Standing leg extension
cue: Hands on a chair, raise one straight leg backwards without arching the back, feel the hamstring and glute.

name: Wall squat
cue: Back against the wall, feet a foot out, slide down by bending the knees, knees behind the toes, tense the thighs on the way up.

name: Seated thigh contraction
cue: Sit upright, straighten and raise one leg, squeeze the thigh muscle and hold.

name: Step-up
cue: Step up with one foot, bring the other up to join it, step down slowly and in control.

name: Seated hip marching
cue: Sit upright away from the back of the chair, lift one knee as far as comfortable, place the foot down with control, alternate.

name: Stomach crunch
cue: Knees bent, hands behind the ears, lower back pressed into the floor, lift the shoulder blades no more than 7.5 cm and lower slowly.

name: Oblique crunch
cue: Knees rolled to one side (or one hand behind the ear), curl the upper body diagonally across towards the opposite knee.

name: Reverse crunch
cue: Knees bent at 90 degrees, pull the knees to the chest until the tailbone lifts off the floor, lower slowly.

name: Back raise
cue: Lying face down, hands by the temples, raise the shoulders no more than 7.5 cm off the floor, long neck, look down.

name: Back extension on forearms
cue: Lie on the front propped on the forearms, push down on the hands to arch the back gently, hips stay on the floor.

name: Deep abdominal brace
cue: Lying on the back, knees bent, breathe out and gently draw the lower tummy and pelvic floor up towards the chest; hold and breathe.

name: Pelvic tilt
cue: Flatten the lower back into the floor, tense the stomach, then tilt the pelvis towards the heels; rock slowly.

name: Trunk rotation
cue: Feet parallel, shoulders back and down, rotate the upper body to one side without moving the hips.

name: Seated upper-body twist
cue: Sit upright, arms crossed on the shoulders, turn the upper body as far as comfortable without moving the hips.

name: Knee rolls
cue: On the back, knees bent and together, roll the knees to one side keeping both shoulders down.

name: Sideways walking
cue: Feet together, knees soft, step one foot to the side and bring the other to join it; do not drop the hips.

name: Grapevine
cue: Walk sideways crossing one foot over the other; smaller steps work the balance harder, fingers on a wall if needed.

name: Heel-to-toe walk
cue: Place the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other, look forward, fingers on a wall if needed.

name: One-leg stand
cue: Face a wall with fingertips touching it, lift one leg keeping the hips level and a slight bend in the standing leg.

name: Buttock stretch
cue: On the back, cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, pull the lower thigh towards the chest.

name: Lying hamstring stretch
cue: On the back, hold one straight leg below the knee and pull it towards you, other foot on the floor.

name: Standing hamstring stretch
cue: One leg forward on the heel with toes up (or on a step), bend the other knee, hinge forward with a straight back.

name: Seated hamstring stretch
cue: Sit tall with straight legs, bend from the hips and bring the chest towards the thighs, back straight.

name: Inner thigh stretch
cue: Sit tall with the soles of the feet together, hold the feet and lower the knees towards the floor.

name: Calf stretch
cue: Step one leg back straight with the heel down, front knee bent, hands on a wall, push the back heel into the floor.

name: Thigh stretch
cue: Hold the top of the foot and pull the heel towards the buttock, knees together, hips forward, hold a wall for balance.

name: Hip flexor stretch
cue: Step forward, keep the back leg straight, bend the front knee and push the back hip forward.

name: ITB stretch
cue: Cross one leg behind the other, lean away from it and push the hip outwards, feet flat, no bending forward.

name: Knee to chest stretch
cue: On the back, pull one or both knees to the chest with the hands, head down, neck relaxed.

name: Sciatic mobilising stretch
cue: On the back, knee to chest, hold behind the thigh and slowly straighten the knee, then bend and return.

name: Chest stretch
cue: Shoulders back and down, arms out or hands on hips, push the chest forward and up.

name: Upper back stretch
cue: Clasp the hands, extend the arms forward at shoulder height, look down and round the upper back.

name: Side stretch
cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side, or slide one hand down the side of the leg; feel the opposite hip or side.

name: Overhead stretch
cue: Extend the arms over the head and lengthen from toes to fingertips, breathing slowly.

name: Standing forward bend
cue: Feet hip-width, hinge from the waist bringing the chest towards the thighs, legs and back straight.

name: Bottom to heels stretch
cue: On all fours, move the bottom back towards the heels and hold for a breath, back and neck straight.

name: Neck rotation
cue: Sit upright, shoulders down, turn the head slowly towards one shoulder as far as comfortable.

name: Neck stretch
cue: Hold one shoulder down with the opposite hand and tilt the head away from it.

name: Ankle stretch
cue: Leg straight and raised, point the toes away then back towards you.
